visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a view from an airplane window showing a white engine nacelle against a backdrop of fluffy white clouds under a clear sky. A large pink and white text overlay introduces the topic of Visit Japan Web for family members. (2) Two hands holding Taiwanese passports are shown in front of a large blue Doraemon statue at a Japan airport information point. (3) A woman in a black coat is seen from behind, walking through a brightly lit airport terminal while pulling a black rolling suitcase on a tiled floor. (4) A screen recording of a mobile device shows the Visit Japan Web interface, with a user entering dates and travel information into form fields. (5) The recording continues, demonstrating the selection of 'Accompanying Family' within the application menu. (6) A QR code is displayed on the smartphone screen, symbolizing the completion of the registration process. (7) An All Nippon Airways (ANA) airplane is parked at a gate with ground crew nearby. (8) Interior shots of the airport terminal feature large 'Welcome' signs in multiple languages and people walking through the concourse. (9) A view from a moving train shows green vegetation and railway infrastructure passing by outside the window. (10) A final graphic screen appears with a light blue background, listing promotional benefits and discount codes for Visa cardholders.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A cheerful, medium-tempo acoustic guitar track begins, providing a warm and steady rhythmic foundation. A female narrator with a clear and friendly tone introduces the guide for Visit Japan Web. (2) A subtle digital 'pop' sound effect marks a transition as the narrator explains the login process. The background music remains consistent in volume and tempo. (3) As the tutorial moves into data entry, a soft 'click' sound effect accompanies the visual highlight of the 'Accompanying Family' section. The narrator's speech rate is moderate and informative. (4) A gentle 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the video shifts from the screen recording to scenery. The narrator emphasizes saving QR codes for offline use. (5) In the final phase, the narration shifts to mentioning travel discounts. The acoustic guitar melody continues brightly before fading out smoothly as the video ends.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Tutorial -> Critical Tips -> Promotional Offer
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a practical guide for travelers visiting Japan with family, specifically explaining how to use the Visit Japan Web service for multiple people under one account. It concludes by promoting Visa card benefits for travel-related services.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of Visa discount codes and specific partner offers from TableCheck and Expedia.
